project_data.project_requirements: Web application for e-commerce with medium complexity

The application should be delivered within the estimated timeline

Test reports and quality assurance documentation

features.name: User authentication
features.description: Implement user registration, login, and password reset functionalities to allow users to create accounts and securely access their profiles.
user_stories: As a user, I want to register with email and password so that I can create an account.
As a user, I want to log in to my account so that I can access my profile.
As a user, I want to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account.

features.name: Product catalog
features.description: Build a comprehensive product catalog system to display and manage products with categories, filtering, and search capabilities.
user_stories: As a user, I want to browse products by category so that I can find items I'm interested in.
As a user, I want to search for products so that I can quickly find specific items.
As a user, I want to filter products by price and rating so that I can narrow down my choices.
As a user, I want to view detailed product information so that I can make informed decisions.

features.name: Shopping cart
features.description: Implement shopping cart functionality allowing users to add, remove, and update product quantities before checkout.
user_stories: As a user, I want to add products to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items.
As a user, I want to update quantities in my cart so that I can adjust my order.
As a user, I want to remove items from my cart so that I can change my mind about purchases.
As a user, I want to see the total cost in my cart so that I know how much I'll pay.

features.name: Checkout process
features.description: Create a secure checkout flow with order review, shipping information, and payment processing.
user_stories: As a user, I want to enter my shipping address so that products can be delivered to me.
As a user, I want to review my order before paying so that I can confirm everything is correct.
As a user, I want to complete payment securely so that I can finalize my purchase.
As a user, I want to receive an order confirmation so that I have proof of my purchase.

features.name: Order management
features.description: Provide users with the ability to view order history, track shipments, and manage their orders.
user_stories: As a user, I want to view my order history so that I can track past purchases.
As a user, I want to see the status of my current orders so that I know when to expect delivery.
As a user, I want to cancel an order if needed so that I can change my mind.
As a user, I want to track my shipment so that I know where my package is.

features.name: Payment integration
features.description: Integrate secure payment gateway to process credit card transactions and handle payment confirmations.
user_stories: As a user, I want to pay with credit card so that I can complete my purchase.
As a user, I want my payment information to be secure so that my data is protected.
As a user, I want to receive payment confirmation so that I know my transaction was successful.

timeline.description: Establish project requirements, design system architecture, and create UI/UX mockups
Implement core features, integrate third-party services, and build the application
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
Deploy to production, configure infrastructure, and provide training
